findings.resolution: The pure view model consumes only typed run fields; it does not synthesize path order, authority, live dependency availability, execution, applied healing or conflict semantics from narrative text.
Evidence states remain distinct, sensitive source and attribute fields are not rendered, and missing or duplicate citations are withheld from impact linkage and surfaced as integrity signals.
A terminal completed run without an effective decision renders INCOMPLETE; current API decisions remain distinct from recorded audit-only history.
Input changes, new submissions and failed follow-ups clear the previous run so evidence cannot appear bound to a different request.
Generic empty inputs, arbitrary renamed fixtures, stable keyboard-operable tab panels, mobile coverage and escaped dynamic text prevent demo coupling and unsafe presentation.
Ordered path receipts, A6 advisory payloads, /health durability display, runtime response validation, zero-sample fixtures and automated axe/contrast auditing remain explicit follow-up work.
